overview.title: Overview

scan.error.title: Could not read the file

result.safe.allowed: The file is on Genra's known-safe list
result.safe.not_office: Not an Office file: this version only looks inside Excel, Word and PowerPoint files
result.malware.title: This file contains malware
result.suspicious.title: This file needs a look
result.plan: Genra will clean it for you
result.plan.soon: Automatic cleaning (clean the file, remove the worm from the PC, undo for 30 days) is coming in v0.1.
result.plan.meanwhile: Until then: do not open this file in Excel or Word, and do not forward it.

report.privacy: Only the file's SHA-256 hash, the rule id, the app version, the OS and your note are sent. The file is not sent.
report.note.placeholder: For example: our office template, used for years
report.done: Sent. Thank you, Genra will review this file.

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.empty.title: Nothing in quarantine
quarantine.empty.text: When Genra quarantines or cleans a file, the original stays here for 30 days and can be restored. Quarantine and undo are coming in v0.1.
settings.title: Settings
settings.privacy.text: Genra reads files on this PC and never sends them anywhere. Only when you press “report a mistake” are the file's hash and your note sent to Genra.
